about.title: About Mortgage Refinance Calculator - Rate and Term Refinancing Tool
about.description: The Mortgage Refinance Calculator helps homeowners compare a current mortgage with potential refinance terms. It shows estimated monthly payment changes, total interest differences, and break-even timing so you can review how a refinance may affect overall loan costs. Use it as a planning reference when comparing refinance scenarios.

howTo.title: How to Use the Mortgage Refinance Calculator

steps.title: Enter Current Mortgage Details

steps.title: Set New Loan Terms

steps.title: Add Closing Costs
steps.description: Include estimated closing costs and fees for the refinancing transaction.

steps.title: Compare Monthly Payments
steps.description: Review how refinancing affects your monthly mortgage payment.

steps.title: Calculate Break-Even Point
steps.description: Determine how long it takes to recoup closing costs through payment savings.

steps.title: Analyze Total Savings
steps.description: Review total interest savings over the life of the new loan.

tips: Refinancing outcomes depend on rate changes, fees, loan term, and how long you expect to keep the loan
Consider how long you plan to stay in the home when evaluating break-even
Factor in all closing costs, not just the interest rate difference
Consider changing loan terms to compare faster payoff against lower monthly payments

faq.q: When should I consider refinancing my mortgage?
faq.a: Consider refinancing when rates drop 0.5-1% below your current rate, you want to change loan terms, need to remove PMI, or want to switch from ARM to fixed-rate. Also consider if you plan to stay in the home long enough to recoup closing costs.

faq.q: How much does it cost to refinance a mortgage?
faq.a: Refinancing typically costs 2-5% of the loan amount in closing costs. This includes origination fees (0.5-1%), appraisal ($300-600), title insurance, and other fees. Some lenders offer no-cost refinancing with slightly higher rates.

faq.q: How long does the refinancing process take?
faq.a: Mortgage refinancing typically takes 30-45 days from application to closing. This includes time for application processing, appraisal, underwriting, and final approval. Having documents ready can speed up the process.

faq.q: Can I refinance if my home value has decreased?
faq.a: Refinancing with decreased home value is challenging but possible. You may need to bring cash to closing, consider government programs like HARP, or wait for home values to recover. Lenders typically require 80% LTV or lower.
